content: {"answer_blocks": [{"text": "Whether an 11-month rent agreement in Madhya Pradesh must be registered depends on the lease term and rent, because under the Indian Registration Act and lease rules, a lease from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent, must be made by a registered instrument", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "[IN.RA1908:s17:ss1@en@1909-01-01]", "quote": "instruments of gift of immovable property"}]}, {"text": "The State Government may, by order published in the Official Gazette, exempt from the operation of this sub-section any lease executed in any district, or part of a district, the terms granted by which do not exceed five years and the rent reserved by which do not exceed fifty rupees.", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "[IN.RA1908:s17:ss1@exhibit_id:MP.LRCDR2018:form_ii@en@2019-02-01~2]", "quote": "If demarcation could not be done, reasons to be recorded"}]}], "abstain": false, "abstain_reason": ""}

{"answer_blocks": [{"text": "Under the Indian Registration Act, 1877, instruments of gift of immovable property and other non-testamentary instruments creating or assigning rights to immovable property valued at one hundred rupees and upwards must be registered when the property is situated in a district where the Act is in force.", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "IN.RA1908:s17:ss1@en@1909-01-01", "quote": "The following documents shall be registered, if the property to which they relate is situate in a district in which, and if they have been executed on or after the date on which, Act No. XVI of 1864, or the Indian Registration Act, 1866, or the Indian Registration Act, 1871, or the Indian Registration Act, 1877, or this Act came or comes into force, namely:—"}]}], "abstain": false, "abstain_reason": ""}

{"answer_blocks": [{"text": "यदि ठेकेदार मज़दूरी नहीं देता है, तो मुख्य नियोक्ता भुगतान के लिए उत्तरदायी हो सकता है।\n\nयदि ठेकेदार लाइसेंस नहीं रखता है, तो ऐसे रोजगार को इस कोड के प्रावधानों का उल्लंघन माना जाएगा।", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "IN.OSHC2020:s55:ss3@en@2025-11-21", "quote": "the principal employer shall be liable to make payment of the wages in full or the unpaid balance due, as the case may be, to the concerned contract labour employed by the contractor and recover the amount so paid from the contractor either by deduction from any amount payable to the contractor under any contract or as a debt payable by the contractor."}]},{"text": "मुख्य नियोक्ता वह व्यक्ति है जो स्थापना के पर्यवेक्षण और नियंत्रण के लिए जिम्मेदार है।", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "IN.OSHC2020:s2:ss1:cl_zz@en@2025-11-20", "quote": "any person responsible for the supervision and control of the establishment"}]},{"text": "यदि ठेकेदार वेतन नहीं देता है, तो उपयुक्त सरकार लाइसेंसधारी अधिकारी द्वारा जारी लाइसेंस के तहत जमा सुरक्षा जमा राशि से भुगतान का आदेश दे सकती है।", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "IN.OSHC2020:s55:ss4@en@2025-11-21", "quote": "The appropriate Government, in the event the contractor does not pay the wages to the contract labour employed by him, shall pass the orders of making payment of such wages from the amount deposited by such contractor as security deposit under the licence issued by the licensing officer to the contractor, in such manner as may be prescribed by such Government."}]}]

{"answer_blocks": [{"text": "यदि पट्टा समाप्त होने पर मकान मालिक ने कब्जा वापस लिया है, तो यह \"by express surrender; that is to say, in case the lessee yields up his interest under the lease to the lessor, by mutual agreement between them\" के रूप में निर्धारित हो सकता है। [IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-07-01]\n\nयदि पट्टे की शर्त टूटने पर मकान मालिक ने कब्जा वापस लिया है, तो यह \"forfeiture; that is to say, (1) in case the lessee breaks an express condition which provides that, on breach thereof, the lessor may re-enter\" के अंतर्गत आ सकता है। [IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-01]\n\nयदि पट्टा समाप्त होने पर मकान मालिक ने कब्जा वापस लिया है, तो यह \"by efflux of the time limited thereby\" के अनुसार निर्धारित हो सकता है। [IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-07-01]", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-07-01", "quote": "by express surrender; that is to say, in case the lessee yields up his interest under the lease to the lessor, by mutual agreement between them"}, {"chunk_id": "IN.TPA182:s111@en@1882-07-01", "quote": "forfeiture; that is to say, (1) in case the lessee breaks an express condition which provides that, on breach thereof, the lessor may re-enter"}, {"chunk_id": "IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-07-01", "quote": "by efflux of the time limited thereby"}]}]

{"answer_blocks": [{"text": "मकान मालिक ने अभी मेरा सामान बाहर फेंक दिया और ताला लगा दिया, मैं रात में कहाँ जाऊँ?\n\nयदि मकान मालिक ने लीज़ की शर्त तोड़ी है, तो लीज़ समाप्त हो सकती है। प्रक्रिया के अनुसार, \"by forfeiture; that is to say, (1) in case the lessee breaks an express condition which provides that, on breach thereof, the lessor may re-enter ***; or (2) in case the lessee renounces his character as such by setting up a title in a third person or by claiming title in himself; [or (3) the lessee is adjudicated an insolvent and the lease provides that the lessor may re-enter on the happening of such event]; and in [any of these cases] the lessor or his transferee [gives notice in writing to the lessee of] his intention to determine the lease\"", "citations": [{"chunk_id": "[IN.TPA1882:s111@en@1882-04-01]", "quote": "by forfeiture; that is to say, (1) in case the lessee breaks an express condition which provides that, on breach thereof, the lease may re-enter ***; or (2) in case the lessee renounces his character as such by setting up a title in a third person or by setting up a title in a third person or by claiming title in himself; [or (3) the lessee is adjudicated an insolvent and the lease provides that the lessor may re-enter on the happening of such event]; and in [any of these cases] the lessor or his transferee [gives notice in writing to the lessee of] his intention to determine the lease"}]}], "abstain": false, "abstain_reason": ""}

E1 states that compulsory registration applies to \"leases of immovable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent.\" E2 confirms that leases for a term exceeding one year must be made by a registered instrument, but does not require registration for shorter leases.", "citations": [{"ref": "E1", "quote": "leases of immovable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent"}, {"ref": "E2", "quote": "A lease of immoveable property from year to year, or for any term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent, can be made only by a registered instrument"}], "citations": [{"ref": "E1", "quote": "leases of immovable property from year to year, or for any quote"}, {"ref": "ref:E2", "quote": "A lease of immoveable property from year to step exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent, can be made only by a registered instrument"}]}]}
